svg.text: NoteKit — Grounded Course Notes RAG Architecture
Cited notes from retrieved sources, honest refusal when evidence is thin, and evaluation that never blocks the reader.

text.tspan: Saved courses · section progress · bookmark position

svg.text: HOT LANE — COURSE GENERATION (THE ONLY PATH THE READER WAITS ON)
Guard: courses built only from uploaded material never widen to web sources.
COLD LANE — SOURCE INGESTION (RUNS ONCE PER TOPIC, NEVER BLOCKS READING)
Later courses on the same topic reuse the cached corpus. Uploaded material is indexed into isolated per-user namespaces.
SIDE LANE — EVALUATION & OBSERVABILITY (NEVER GATES THE RESPONSE)
A shared password gates the deployed instance.
Namespaces isolate browsers, not people — not per-user auth.
1 Every factual claim must be supported.
2 Cite the numbered passage inline as [c#].
3 Refuse when passages do not cover the topic.

text.tspan: One tracing hook in llm.py; purpose, tokens, cache reads,
latency and errors. Tracing failures are swallowed.
Sections arrive in completion order with their index.
A mid-stream failure is emitted as an SSE error event.

svg.text: Stack: Python · FastAPI · LangGraph · PostgreSQL/pgvector · sentence-transformers · Anthropic API · Langfuse · Next.js · React · TypeScript
